page.dashboard: Shows the server right now: how many are online, who needs help and what staff did last. You can also change weather and time or send an announcement here.
page.players: Everyone in the server right now. Pick a player to see their file, move, heal or kick them. Offline players are under Characters.
page.characters: Every saved character by citizen ID, online or not. Change money and jobs, suspend a character or delete it from here.
page.bans: Who is banned from the server and which characters are suspended. Lift a ban or a suspension here and they can play again.
page.map: The world map with players live on it. Click a player to go to them or bring them, or click a spot to teleport there.
page.world: Changes weather and time for every player at once, and sends an announcement everyone sees on screen.
page.tools: Your own staff tools: fly, go invisible, heal, spawn a horse and more. They affect only you unless stated.
page.hub: Every script of the server in one place. Open a script's own interface or change its settings; its own interface keeps working as before.
page.hud: Player HUD settings from the w_hud script: how fast hunger and thirst drop, their damage and what shows on screen. Saved changes reach everyone at once.
page.resources: The scripts running on the server. Start, stop or restart one; players may notice its feature pause for a few seconds.
page.perms: Your current website permissions. This page is read only; delegated role changes belong on the Ranks page.
page.log: Everything staff did from this panel: who did what, to whom and when. Useful when you need to check or undo something.
page.settings: Settings of this panel for you only: language, table size, help mode and motion. Nobody else is affected.
page.kit: A sample of every component of the panel for developers to review. It exists only in the browser copy, never on the server.
page.news: The news card of the pause menu (Esc in the game). Add, edit, order or delete the news here; players see a change at once, and it stays after a restart.
page.blips: The blips every player sees on the game's own map: add, edit, delete and go to them. This page shows only while the w_map map script is stopped.
page.ranks: Staff ranks and what each one allows. Create a rank, choose its permissions, and give it to a player or take it away, online or not. Changes apply at once.
page.reports: The players’ reports, the same list as the website Reports page. Take, answer and close them here.

nav.text: The side menu: each name opens a page of the panel, and you only see the pages your level allows. The number beside each section opens it from the keyboard; press it again for the next page in it.
nav.title: Side menu

navCollapse.text: Shrinks the side menu to a thin strip so the page gets more room. Your choice is remembered next time.
navCollapse.title: Collapse menu

palette.text: Quickly find a player by name, citizen ID or session number like #5, or jump to a page or tool. Shortcut Ctrl+K.
palette.title: Quick search
palette.example: Type 12 to open the owner of citizen ID 12

online.text: How many players are online right now, out of the most the server accepts.
online.title: Online

helpMode.text: Turns on help mode: every ? stands out, and pressing one tells you what that thing does. Shortcut F1.
helpMode.title: Help mode
helpMode.undo: Yes, press it again or F1

quick.text: Opens the small quick menu at the side of the screen, so you can use your tools while watching the game. Shortcut F10.
quick.title: Quick menu

close.text: Closes the admin panel and takes you back to the game. Nothing you did is cancelled. Shortcut Esc.
close.title: Close the panel

whoami.text: Your staff account and website role. Its permissions decide which pages and actions you can use.
whoami.title: Your account

palette.open: Find a player, citizen ID or tool…
palette.placeholder: Name, citizen ID like 12, session like #5, or a page
palette.empty: Nothing found. Try the citizen ID, or # and the session number.

shell.helpBanner: Help mode is on: press any ? to see what it does.
shell.noPages: No pages are allowed for your level.
